title: A Uniform for the Bridge
author: D. M. Marchetti
blurb: Elodie Delacroix, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
